description.value: The Modern Bakeshop & Cafe is a heritage artisan bakery and coffee shop in the heart of Revelstoke, in operation since 1903. It is known for freshly baked goods made with organic ingredients — standout items highlighted by reviewers include Aussie meat pies, sticky cinnamon buns, and housemade chai lattes — alongside expertly brewed espresso drinks. The space offers a cozy indoor atmosphere and outdoor seating, drawing both local regulars and travelers passing through.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is real and active at 212 MacKenzie Ave, Revelstoke, matching the OSM address; recent reviews (2024) and an active booking system support confirmed_open=true. The about-us page explicitly states 'gluten-free dining, vegetarian specials, and vegan fine dining options,' and a reviewer corroborates gluten-free offerings. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or takeout was found in the accessible website content; OSM's internet_access=yes tag is not treated as authoritative per the rules.
concerns: OSM record had no phone number; website shows +1 250-837-6886 — used website value.

Opening hours discrepancy: OSM lists Mo-Sa 07:00-17:00, website shows Sunday–Saturday 08:00–15:00. Additionally, the website front page states 'Sunday Closed' while the contact page lists Sunday as open, indicating an internal inconsistency on the website itself.
OSM internet_access=yes not confirmed by website content; Wi-Fi left as null.
Menu, gallery, and blog subpages returned Cloudflare rate-limit errors (Error 1015); some amenity details such as takeout or packed lunch options may have been missed as a result.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating artisan bakery and cafe in central Revelstoke with a live website, recent customer reviews, and confirmed contact information — a useful stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: About-us page states: 'Guests can enjoy gluten-free dining, vegetarian specials, and vegan fine dining options.' Reviewer Lisa Goodwin also notes 'Gluten free treats that are moist and flavour full!'

wow_evidence: in operation since 1903; heritage artisan bakery in the heart of Revelstoke
